description: Land Title Settlement Department - Suwarapola, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 521201
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances) in various locations. The content focuses on land ownership registration, property titles, and land settlement matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
